subject: Re: Submodular status: enron replication done, influence-max 20x slower
body:
Team,

Decision: Q3 scope is coverage-only, per Csilla's recommendation. Influence maximization stays a research thread with no OKR attached — I have written it out of the draft OKRs before Friday's lock.

Timeline: the June graph snapshot comes out of our cirrus-tpu week starting Jun 29; Bilal, please have the A/B harness ready to consume it the following week so the freshness experiment design is credible in the Q3 OKR review.

Giannis — nice work getting the port to match oracle-call counts bit-for-bit; put a short note on the deterministic-randomness trick in the team wiki.

Anders
